    User->>App: Enter username and password
    App->>Auth: POST /login (credentials)
    Auth->>Auth: Validate credentials
    alt Invalid credentials
        Auth-->>App: 401 Unauthorized
        App-->>User: Display error message
    else Valid credentials
        Auth->>SMS: Generate and send 2FA challenge / OTP
        SMS-->>User: Deliver OTP / push notification
        Auth-->>App: 200 OK (Requires 2FA, session token)
        App-->>User: Prompt for 2FA code
        
        User->>App: Enter 2FA code
        App->>Auth: POST /verify-2fa (session token, code)
        Auth->>Auth: Validate 2FA code
        alt Invalid / expired code
            Auth-->>App: 401 Invalid 2FA code
            App-->>User: Show retry / invalid code prompt
        else Valid code
            Auth-->>App: 200 OK (Access & Refresh tokens)
            App-->>User: Redirect to Dashboard / Logged in
        end
    end

flowchart TD
    Start([Customer Requests Refund]) --> CheckWindow{Within return\nwindow?}

    CheckWindow -- No --> RejectWindow[Reject Refund\n'Outside return period']
    CheckWindow -- Yes --> CheckReceipt{Valid proof of\npurchase?}

    CheckReceipt -- No --> RejectReceipt[Reject or Request Receipt]
    CheckReceipt -- Yes --> CheckReason{Item defective\nor damaged?}

    CheckReason -- Yes --> ApproveFullDefect[Approve Full Refund\nor Replacement]
    CheckReason -- No --> CheckCondition{Item returned in\noriginal condition?}

    CheckCondition -- Yes --> ApproveFull[Approve Full Refund]
    CheckCondition -- Minor wear --> ApprovePartial[Approve Partial Refund /\nStore Credit]
    CheckCondition -- Damaged / Used --> RejectCondition[Reject Refund &\nReturn Item to Customer]

    RejectWindow --> End([End])
    RejectReceipt --> End
    ApproveFullDefect --> End
    ApproveFull --> End
    ApprovePartial --> End
    RejectCondition --> End
